description: Search NeutralPick's company list: software companies listed for free, with facts only (name, website, one line about what they do, categories, countries). Most listed themselves, for free; some were added by NeutralPick from public information on their own websites and are marked so. It is not an endorsement, a review or a ranking: no company can pay to be listed or shown, results are a random selection of at most 8 matches and their order means nothing, and the list is small, so many good companies aren't in it. Use it alongside other sources and say where each name came from.

country.description: Optional: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the person's country, e.g. "IN". Only companies that sell there (or worldwide).

what.description: What the person is looking for, in plain words, e.g. "payroll for a shop with 12 staff".
